in_hebrew.name: Dyana
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Dyana הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'dios' meaning divine, and 'ana' meaning upward or heavenward. In Christian spirituality, the name Dyana symbolizes a connection to the divine and a striving towards the heavens.
